tasks.analysis: The best method for dating a surface uses radioactivity, the process by which certain elements decay over time. One collects rocks from the surface and measures their radioactive elements to see how much of the decay products have accumulated in the rock since it formed. Transferring this age to the age of the surface can be tricky unless one knows where the rock came from. And one needs to collect the samples and bring them to a well-equipped laboratory. 测定地表年代的最佳方法是利用放射性 —— 即某些元素随时间推移发生衰变的过程。人们从地表采集岩石，通过测量其中的放射性元素，来判断自岩石形成以来衰变产物在岩石中积累的量。但要将岩石的年代转化为地表的年代并非易事，除非清楚岩石的来源。此外，还需要采集样本并将其送往设备完善的实验室进行分析。
